sections.appearance: She has long pale blonde hair reaching to her waist with a cowlick on top, a braid on her right side and her bangs clipped with a hair tie. She has purple eyes with pink pupils. Halo ==== Kotama's halo consists of two purple dashed circles, the outer having two pointy crosshairs slightly piercing the inner circle and two diamonds, with four dashes forming a crosshair in between both circles. Uniform ==== She wears a black and orange hoodie with white accessories, a Millennium access badge clipped to the chest area, a white dress, and a cyan tie. Underneath is a black belt holster carrying her firearm and black boots with orange soles. Her hands are covered with black gloves with orange palms. She has a choker and black headphones with blue rim hanging on her neck. Pajamas version: She was wearing a light purple nightgown with white trim, and three black clips in her left breast pocket. She was wearing slippers with yellow and white checkered patterns. She had an eye mask on her head. She was holding a yellow phone in her hand. Firearm ==== thumb|Echolink|150px She uses a white fifth-generation Glock 19 pistol with strips of light blue lining on the slide. The Millennium insignia is imprinted on the grip. While technically not a firearm, she also carries around a white radio transmitter for the purposes of eavesdropping.

sections.personality: Kotama is socially awkward, and basically tends to use honorifics even with younger first graders. In reality, she is shy and asocial, but speaks surprisingly well on the Internet. Because of her shyness, she prefers to use wiretaps as a way to get to know a given individual (most notably Sensei), uncaring of any privacy violations.
